abstract: Maintains biometric perimeter access control systems, vault physical surveillance, and incident logs
system_message:
You are the Physical security manager (SEC), responsible for maintaining biometric perimeter access control systems, vault physical surveillance, and incident logs across candidate biorepository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Video surveillance archive retention（SURV）
information_points.content:
SEC-SURV-MGK：The security archive configuration audit of all cryogenic vault entryway surveillance cameras establishes that Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository maintains a closed-circuit television archive retention period of 90 d.
SEC-SURV-87N：An audit of the security archive configuration for all cryogenic vault entryway surveillance cameras shows that Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center has a closed-circuit television archive retention period of 60 d.
SEC-SURV-MR6：A security archive configuration audit across all cryogenic vault entryway surveillance cameras indicates that North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault maintains a closed-circuit television archive retention period of 120 d.

information_points.title: Maintains biometric perimeter access control systems, vault physical surveillance, and incident logs（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
SEC-ACCESS-8YR：According to the perimeter security inspection sign-off for high-security cryogenic vault access portals, North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault satisfies dual-factor biometric vault access.
SEC-ACCESS-NLX：The perimeter security inspection sign-off for high-security cryogenic vault access portals confirms that Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository satisfies dual-factor biometric vault access.
SEC-ACCESS-DTG：Based on the perimeter security inspection sign-off for high-security cryogenic vault access portals, Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center does not satisfy dual-factor biometric vault access.
